svg.title: A loop inside a loop: the first two squares
svg.desc: An animation, seen from above, of the first two passes of the nested-loop program from Lesson 1-10. Beside the robot, the five lines of the program, with the one running highlighted, and a box showing the counters square, side and size. On the first pass of the outer loop, square is 0 and size works out to 20; the inner loop then runs four times, side counting 0 to 3, and the robot draws a 20 cm square in blue and ends back on its start mark. On the second pass square is 1 and size is 25, and the robot draws a 25 cm square in purple from the same corner, around the first one. The animation stops there; the remaining two passes would draw 30 and 35 cm squares the same way.
